stem.text: A length of wire is connected into a circuit.

stem.alt: Wire drawn as a tube that narrows from left to right. Labels: area A at the wide left end, R at the wide end of the taper, S at the narrow part after the taper, and area ½A at the narrow right end.

stem.text: The area of the cross-section of the wire changes from $A$ at R to $\dfrac{1}{2}A$ at S.
There is a constant current in the wire. Charge $Q$ passes R in time $t$.
What is the charge passing point S in the same time $t$?
